Remove batching logic from the client

why_en: Pipelining improves throughput by batching network round trips, not by making one Redis server execute commands in parallel.
tradeoff: 吞吐与 RTT amortization vs 客户端批量管理

termDefinitions.meaning: commodity hardware 是常规可采购服务器，单机不特殊，靠数量和架构扩展。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Commodity hardware means standard servers whose scale comes from quantity and architecture rather than specialized machines.
